cues: Newton assumed isothermal changes, so B equals P, giving two hundred and eighty metres per second, sixteen percent too low.
Laplace realised the changes are adiabatic, so B equals gamma P, giving three hundred and thirty one, which agrees.
text: Side by side. Newton assumed isothermal changes, so B equals P, giving two hundred and eighty metres per second, sixteen percent too low. Laplace realised the changes are adiabatic, so B equals gamma P, giving three hundred and thirty one, which agrees.
